input_messages.content: Hi there! I just got my order and, well, I’m a bit confused. The hiking boots I received look like someone already took them for a hike before me! Also, I got a jigsaw puzzle, but I’d love to swap it for a fancier one with fewer pieces—like 500 less—but still want it to be just as challenging. Can you help me out with both?
Oh, I always forget my email—sorry! But my name is Yara Ito and my zip code is 75284. Will that work?
Oh, I don’t have the order ID handy right now—my desk is a total mess! Is there another way you can look it up? Maybe by the items or my name? I just got the package today if that helps!

Thanks for finding those! For the boots, I’d like to exchange them for a new pair—same style and size, just, you know, not pre-worn! And yes, I’d love to swap the puzzle for a fancier one with 500 fewer pieces but still tricky.

PayPal works for me for any price changes or refunds. Let’s go ahead with both exchanges, please!

Ooh, the fantasy theme sounds awesome! Let’s go with that one, please.

And yes, I want the same hiking boots—same style and size, just a fresh pair.

Let me know what’s next!
Yes, that’s all correct! Please go ahead and start the exchanges. Thank you so much for your help!
That’s perfect, thank you! I’ll keep an eye out for the email. Appreciate your help—have a great day! ###STOP###
